sample_from_multiple_pipelines_with_weig: sample from multiple data pipelines using weighted probabilities with a fixed random seed for reproducibility
sample_with_allow_repeats_false: sample from multiple data pipelines without repeating items from the same pipeline until all are exhausted
sample_with_single_pipeline: sample from a single data pipeline which simply returns all items in order without shuffling
sample_with_infinite_pipeline: sample from a mix of finite and infinite data pipelines where the infinite one repeats its contents
save_and_restore_sample_state: save the state of a sampling pipeline and restore it to resume from a specific point in the sequence
